thread:
olivia_csm: Heads up — Ravenbrook renewal flagged for next quarter. Usage is healthy but they're seeing latency spikes during peak windows and asked about cost reduction. Thinking a short canary: int8 quantized model for low-cost routes + route lower-priority requests to a smaller variant. Need ops + SRE sign-off and a quick eval plan.

maria_cs: Do we have concrete numbers on savings vs risk? they'll want percent savings and rollback plan. Also any QoS hit?

olivia_csm: Quick snapshot from last 48h: avg p50 160ms, p95 420ms, tail spikes up to 1.2s when concurrency > 80. Cost per 1M tokens served ~ $420 on current model. Early estimate: int8 quant -> ~30-40% cost reduction on token compute, tradeoff ~+10-30ms median latency but less queueing since throughput increases. Important: tail behavior may improve because smaller kernel reduces contention.

ash_engineer: I can produce a verified int8 build of m-raven-v2 and run our eval harness against their sample prompts. Need their eval set & a metric set (BLEU/ROUGE/LLM-score) for regressions. Suggest canary traffic at 5-10% for 48 hours, evaluate automated metrics + manual sampling.

leo_sre: From infra side, we should avoid autoscale gaps — propose bumping min replicas for that pool during canary and enable per-route prefix caching for repeated assistant prompts. Also add a short-term routing policy: route non-critical inference (batch indexing, embeddings) to m-small-v1 and keep critical chat on primary. That reduces headroom pressure.

olivia_csm: I'll ask Ravenbrook for a 200-example eval set and permission to run a 48h 10% canary. Planned customer message: "We propose a brief canary using a quantized variant to reduce unit costs while monitoring quality closely. If metrics or sample quality degrade, we'll roll back immediately." Want input on phrasing.

maria_cs: Phrase looks good. Add an explicit rollback SLA: "rollback within 30 minutes if error rate or quality delta beyond threshold". They like exact SLAs.

ash_engineer: Agreed. Also here's the quick canary deploy command I'll use:```bash
redwoodctl deploy --customer ravenbrook --model m-raven-v2:int8 --route canary --weight 0.10 --tag canary-raven-2026-03
```

nash_engineer: And eval run (local):```text
running eval on 200 samples...
pass: 186/200
avg_similarity: 0.982
max_delta_metric: 0.012
notes: small formatting diffs on long tables
```

leo_sre: I kicked off routing rule stub and set autoscale min=3 for canary pool. Also configured short-term alert: p95 > 700ms OR error_rate > 0.5% triggers immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary started for ravenbrook (canary id: rb-canary-56f9). Weight: 10%. Rolling out to region us-west-2.

olivia_csm: Great. Action items: 1) ash -> full eval + sample batch for manual review (ETA 12h). 2) leo -> confirm autoscale/alerts are live (ETA 2h). 3) olivia -> customer outreach + SLA wording (ETA 4h). We'll reconvene after 24h check-in.

maria_cs: Also capture feedback in Gainsight/renewal doc. I'll log the potential savings estimate and include canary outcome as renewal talking point.

ash_engineer: Will add regression snapshots to the ticket: https://redwood.internal/issue/RB-9874 (sample diffs attached).

leo_sre: Quick note — if we see tail >1s still, plan B is routing smaller chat model for non-critical flows and enabling KV prefix caching for repeated contexts.

olivia_csm: Thanks team. I'll post a short update to Ravenbrook once we have the eval set. Fingers crossed this reduces cost and gives them confidence for renewal. :crossed_fingers:
